title: RabbitMQ
description: Brokers, throughput, per-queue and per-exchange metrics (rabbitmq_prometheus) and broker logs.

panels.title: Alarms
panels.description: Memory, disk and file descriptor alarms. While one is raised, publishers are blocked.

targets.expr: (sum(rabbitmq_alarms_memory_used_watermark{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(rabbitmq_alarms_free_disk_space_watermark{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(rabbitmq_alarms_file_descriptor_limit{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Queues without consumers
panels.description: Messages routed to these queues pile up until a consumer attaches.

panels.title: Memory used / watermark
panels.description: At 100% the memory alarm blocks publishers (vm_memory_high_watermark).

panels.title: Problem rates
panels.description: Redeliveries usually mean consumers failing (nack/requeue or crash). Unroutable messages were published to an exchange with no matching binding.

panels.title: Connection churn
panels.description: Sustained churn means clients reconnecting in a loop.

panels.title: Queues
panels.description: Per-queue state (/metrics/detailed). Rates over the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (vhost, queue) (rate({__name__=~"rabbitmq_detailed_queue_messages_delivered(_ack)?_total", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", vhost=~"$vhost", queue=~"$queue"}[5m]))

panels.title: Redelivery rate by queue
panels.description: A consumer is failing on this queue's messages (nack + requeue, or it crashed before acking).

panels.title: Unroutable by exchange
panels.description: Messages that matched no binding: a missing queue/binding or a wrong routing key.

panels.title: Broker logs
panels.description: RabbitMQ container stdout, collected by the node agent.
